verified: NariQ's model card publishes BF16, 3-bit, 2.5-bit and 2-bit scores for DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench 2.1, AIME 25+26, MSGM and RealWorldQA, and a commit in the same repository describes the DeepSWE figures as three-round averages with per-cell task counts and Docker-based runs (tool-3-1). The card also states that running these files currently requires NariQ's own llama.cpp fork.
unconfirmed: All scores are author-reported with no independent replication, and the release does not say what the 4K–64K context-length numbers (88.9 up to 111.7) actually measure, so the claim that decode speed is comparable to other quants rests on the vendor's word; several 3-bit and 2.5-bit results also come out above the BF16 baseline without explanation, and the Terminal-Bench version cited, 2.1, is not the 4.1 release listed on the benchmark's own site (tool-3-3).

verified: NariQ 在 Hugging Face 上发布了 Qwen3.8-27B 的 3-bit 及更低比特量化版本，发布页列出了 DeepSWE、Terminal-Bench 2.1、AIME 25+26、MSGM、RealWorldQA 五组基准上 BF16 与 3-bit／2.5-bit／2-bit 的对比数字，并说明目前必须使用其自建的 llama.cpp 分支（nari-llama.cpp）才能运行；模型仓库的提交说明显示 DeepSWE 为三轮平均、在 Docker 环境中逐题统计并给出样本数（tool-3-1）。
unconfirmed: “接近 BF16 质量”和“首个在长程 agentic 任务上保持 BF16 水平”的说法均为作者自报，尚无可查的独立第三方复测；发布内容未交代标题所称 10 GB 文件的具体构成、各基准所用的评测框架版本与 held-out 划分，而公开的 Terminal-Bench 排行榜页面当前已是 4.1 版（tool-3-3），与文中 2.1 版成绩不能直接对比；Mac 上约 3.8 tok/s（M3 Pro，3.0bpw）的推理速度仅见于评论者转述的说明，发布正文未给出。

titles.en: NariQ ships 3-bit Qwen3.8-27B quantizations claiming near-BF16 quality
